text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Shakur! I heard today's your 
birthday, isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Here's a present for you. I'll send you an 
e-ticket to my upcoming modern dance 
recital.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Modern dancing...? What brought that on?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say it before? That your 
songwriting was missing that "something."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Modern dance is the expression of the 
soul. It unleashes all your repressed 
emotions!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think they're kind of similar? 
Just like your music, where you let out 
all your pent-up feelings.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief. Acting like you know 
everything."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I'll take it off your hands, if only to 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Good! I'm looking forward to your cool 
music!"
